author: stefduponcheel
body:
#### PR description:

Phase-2 Outer and Inner Tracker modules and sensors need to be masked out of reconstruction and simulation to study detector failure scenarios. There is currently no dedicated mechanism to do this for the Phase-2 tracker. This PR is the first step: it adds the payload infrastructure to mask hand-specified bad modules/sensors for both the Outer and Inner Tracker, reusing the existing Phase-1  `SiPixelQuality` CondFormat payload. Currently one has to specify the detID's of the modules/sensors one wants to disable in a .txt file. 

This PR consists of four commits:

1. **Adding EventSetup records for Phase-2 bad-components payloads.**  new `SiPhase2InnerTrackerBadModuleRcd/SiPhase2OuterTrackerBadModuleRcd` (`CondFormats/DataRecord`). 
2. **Registering Phase-2 components-module records with `SiPixelQuality` in the CondDB plugin**. Couples both new records to the existing `SiPixelQuality` payload type (`CondCore/SiPhase2TrackerPlugins`).
3. **Adding hand-specified Phase-2 bad-component builder and reader**.  `SiPhase2BadComponentsByHandBuilder` supports two disabling modes from hand-specified text lists of Phase-2 DetIds: whole-module disabling (`badModuleListFile`) and single-sensor disabling (`badSensorListFile`), writing the result as a `SiPixelQuality` payload to sqlite. One target record (OT or IT) is handled per job instance. `SiPhase2BadComponentsByHandReader` reads the payload back and logs each disabled DetId, as a verification tool.
4. **Adding test configs for the Phase-2 bad-component builder and reader**. Used together with example DetId lists and puts them into the package's unit test.

The example DetId list files used by commit 4's test configs live in `cms-data/CondTools-SiPhase2Tracker` repo. A separate PR for that is made over in that repo.

At later stages, other possibilities to populate the DB will be added (like via ESSource). Digitizer extension to accept this payload is also in the works. 


#### PR validation:

-  `cmssw` compiles
-   Unit testing of commit 4 with the  example DetId lists successfully build the payloads and also reads them with reader. 
- `scram build code-checks` and `code-format` come back clean. 
- `runTheMatrix.py -l limited -i all --ibeos`. 33 out of 45 passes (of the 20 initial failures, retested with` -i all`, 8 then passed). This should not be due to added code from the PR since no reconstruction code is touched yet. All 12 failures are real-data workflows failing at Step0 with the same DAS dataset/golden-JSON certification mismatch, including it for completeness:
